CA-R1-001.consequence: Recorded delivery grant bound to trusted policy and current installation/source/enrichment/destination permissions; explicit token-versus-lease lifetime, ordered invalidation, stale-policy hold, persisted invalidation and scope-aware retained payload suppression/replay.

CA-R1-002.consequence: Observation owner explicitly owns enriched views; MCP and CLI share them and parity fixtures include unknown worker/usage/closure evidence. Any existing pinned Python compositor delegation is bounded to A1 and removed in A3.

runtime_port_ownership.consequence: A1 owns the internal Codex execution port; A3 owns observation ports; other runtime implementations remain deferred.

verified_caller.consequence: A2 requires a trusted validated caller result or equivalent configured binding; unverified claim parsing cannot create caller context.
